messages.subject: ajax selectInput choices?
parts:
I have just started developing my first shiny app:

https://arilamstein.shinyapps.io/choroplethrShiny/
https://github.com/trulia/choroplethrShiny

At the highest level, there are a few maps, and users have a dropdown menu where they can select the map they want to view.

I just implemented a zoom feature, as a selectInput, where users can select the regions of the map they want to zoom in on.

The problem is that I want to change the zoom options based on the map they have chosen.  For example, the available regions of the USA State map are different than the available regions on the Country map.

I have looked at the documentation but cannot find a way to do this.  Can someone help?

Thanks.

Ari
